facility.name: The R.a.n.c.h.
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 211 S WALNUT ST, HICO, TX, 76457

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Two small garbage cans were observed on the playground area without lids and accessible to children.  The garbage cans were removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last fire drill documented was observed to have been completed in July 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Employees Discipline Own Children: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that employees used prohibited punishment at the operation when discipling their own children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that written activity plans were not being followed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that prohibited punishment was used when caregivers yelled at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that staff engaged in personal cell phone use while responsible for supervising children in the classroom,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The last gas leak inspection was observed to have been completed in April of 2023.  The gas leak test was scheduled during the inspection..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that one caregiver used poor judgement when speaking to a child using inappropriate language.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that caregivers used prohibited punishment when yelling at children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that corporal punishment and threats of corporal punishment were used.  One caregiver was found to use threats of corporal punishment and to have used a fly swatter and their hand to discipline children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation has not documented a fire drill since January 2024, This was corrected at inspection today when the operation practiced and documented the fire drill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 3 out of the 5 caregivers file selected for review were missing required training topics related to health and safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Personnel that transport children in care did not have current transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: The booster seats located in the transportation van were expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A new employee was clocked in and on the play yard with children in care and other caregivers and the background check is still pending,The caregiver was sent home which brought the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An 11 month-old child was observed sleeping in a crib and a blanket was covering the infant.  The blanket was removed during the inspection, bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: A bottle of Tylenol was in an infant's cubby.  There was no authorization form, the medication was expired, and it was for 2?11-year-olds. This was corrected on-site during the inspection when the bottle was removed from the classroom during this inspection. The risk was mitigated because the child was not present, and the medication seal had not been broken, so no Tylenol had been given to this child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: 4 outlets observed without proper covers.  This was corrected when the covers were replaced.  There were fans within reach of children in 3 classrooms.  The fans were removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: Providers must update their insurance on their portal annually.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined a caregiver has left their classroom occasionally to open the secondary door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 7 month old child was observed sitting in a stroller in the school age class.  The oldest child in this group was 11 years old.  The infant was removed from the classroom bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Children in the school age class were observed playing games on their personal cell phones and IPads.  Based on observations, this was not a structured planned activity with a educational purpose.  The devices were put up during the inspection, bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: A box fan was being used in the prek class, and it was on top of the short file cabinet.  The fan was in reach of the children in care.  It was determined the prek classroom was outside in a breeze way, and the caregiver took the child inside the Gym to use the restroom.  There were multiple paint containers and a can of lysol on the floor in the restoom.  This was corrected when the children came into the main building and had no additional need to use the bathroom in the gym. Verbal TA was provided at he last inspection regarding the fans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: It was determined the prek class were spending outdoor time in the drive-thru covered awning of the church.  There was no fence and this a non-licensed space.  The children came back inside bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: It was found that various training records were not available.  Some employee have not completed the 24 hours in annual training, annual reporting abuse is not in the training records, and one employee that only works summers, had no training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Of the 5 children records reviewed, complete names, addresses, and phone number of emergency contact and emergency treatment authorizations were missing, one child had no enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant class had 6 children, 2 -11 month olds, 2 -16 month olds, and 2 20 month old. The group had 1 caregiver.  The group was out of ratio.  This was corrected when one of the children were moved to another room which brought the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
